# Lucas-TVS — Products, Systems & Engineering Services

> Lucas TVS – Products, Systems & Engineering Services is a global engineering and technology partner helping OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, industrial enterprises and defence organizations develop next-generation products, intelligent systems and digital platforms. Its teams work across embedded systems, software-defined platforms, electronics, controls, cloud, AI and validation, for Automotive, Industrial and Defence & Aerospace programmes.

The engineering teams are based at the India Nippon Electricals Limited (INEL) R&D Tech Center, SIPCOT Industrial Complex, Hosur, Tamil Nadu.

## Company

- [About Us](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/about): who we are, the Lucas TVS group and the Hosur R&D Tech Center
- [Careers](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/careers): roles in electrification, SDV, embedded systems, defence electronics and AI
- [Contact Us](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/contact): engineering enquiries, routed to the team that owns them

## Capabilities

- [Engineering Services](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/capabilities): services spanning embedded systems, electronics, software, safety and validation, from concept to deployment
- [Technologies](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/technologies): the technology areas the engineering teams are organised around
- [Engineering & R&D](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/engineering-rd): labs for electronics, embedded software and validation, including HIL rigs
- [Quality & Standards](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/quality): processes, international standards and validation

## Industries

- [Industries overview](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/industries): one engineering core serving three sectors
- [Automotive](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/industries/automotive): electric powertrain solutions for 2/3/4 wheelers, passenger, commercial, off-highway and specialty vehicles
- [Industrial](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/industries/industrial): smart manufacturing, IIoT, motion and energy for industrial OEMs and manufacturers
- [Defence & Aerospace](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/industries/defence-aerospace): engineering for defence OEMs, system integrators, DPSUs, DRDO laboratories and armed forces programmes

## Products

- [Products & Platforms](https://software.lucas-tvs.com/products): motor controllers, battery management systems, DC-DC converters, chargers, vehicle and body control units, rugged vehicle electronics, embedded processing platforms, motion controllers, energy management systems, edge gateways and condition monitoring units
